defects.detail: Bottom-right box reads 'Ref. Dwg. TJC-LLD-PID-XXXX'; datasheet, GA drawing and C&E cross-reference TJC-LLD-PID-2301, which the sheet itself prints only as the inset header.
NOTE 2 cites 'Datasheet TJC-LLD-DS-GA-1201A' (the GA-1201A pump datasheet); YD-2301's datasheet is TJC-LLD-DS-YD-2301.
NOTE 3 reads 'See SEQ-1201 logic diagram' (GA-1201A's sequence); YD-2301's C&E is LOGIC No SEQ-5500.

GA-1201A tags on a dryer sheet: HS-1201 (local control station), RO-1201 and PDI-1201 (seal-flush inset), motor 'M 30kW EQ1000012011-' (GA-1201A equipment ID and 30 kW rating; YD-2301 datasheet EQ-1000023011, 22 kW).

'PSLL-2303' where C&E T3 is LSHH-2303; 'S5LL 2305' for SSLL-2305 (also 'EFF-3 -> S5LL-2305' and 'EFF-2 -> F5LL-2302'); 'Z50-2304' for permissive ZSO-2304; TSHH-2301 boxed as 'Discharge Flow LOW-LOW 9 m/0h' where C&E T1 is > 125 degC; 'TSHH-2301 (as permissive)' wired to a TRIP box; the EFF-1..EFF-5 boxes point at initiator tags TSHH-2301/F5LL-2302/S5LL-2305/ASHH-2307/MPR-2301; the 'DCS RESET / EFF-3' box labels permissive P3 'Lube oil to gearbox OK' (PSL-2306) as EFF-3; PSL-2306 is also drawn as the output of the MPR-2301 trip; FV-2302 drawn twice ('Trips OPEN' on the N2 purge, 'trips CLOSED' on the outlet riser); TV-2301 (steam inlet per C&E EFF-2) drawn on the powder outlet riser.
Sheet prints '4.0 x 8.5 m EL +6.00'; plot plan TJC-LLD-PP-YD-2301 prints FOOTPRINT 4.0x9.5m(approx) at ELEVATION EL+6.00 (elevation agrees, length does not); GA drawing DRUM LENGTH 9000 mm.

The Set 1 API seal-flush inset (API PLAN 11 + PLAN 62, RO/PDI orifices, External Quench N2/Steam) is reproduced on a rotary steam-tube dryer whose datasheet lists GLAND PACKING PTFE (PILLER 4526L) and no seal flush plan; the inset header carries the drawing title 'P&ID; TJC-LLD-PID-2301 - DRYER SYSTEM (YD-2301)'.
'Matel of construction: SM400B' overlay; '9 m/0h'; 'LAGEND'; 'API PLAN II + PLAN 62'; 'F5LL-2302', 'S5LL 2305', 'Z50-2304'; NOTE 3 lacks a terminal period.
